reviews_verbatim.author: Evan Rosa
reviews_verbatim.text: I highly recommend CEK Caterers! Avi and his team catered my son's Bar Mitzvah and did a great job from start to finish. Avi is so easy to work with. He made planning the event and the menu so easy for us. His team delivered and setup the table linens and the food buffet beautifully. The server was very attentive and there for anything we needed during the event. The food was delicious and exceeded expectations. All of our guests loved it! If you want a Caterer who delivers what they say and will exceed your expectations, hire CEK Caterers for your next event!

reviews_verbatim.author: Chanie Gluck
reviews_verbatim.text: I have used CEK a few times to cater dinner events. They did a fantastic job every time! I highly recommend CEK for all your catering needs.

reviews_verbatim.author: Sandrine Cohen
reviews_verbatim.text: Avi met every single one of our needs and more! His staff was professional and accommodating to all our needs.

reviews_verbatim.author: Dawn Gordon Fisch
reviews_verbatim.text: Avi did an outstanding job making delicious food for my son's Bar Mitzvah. The presentation was beautiful too.

reviews_verbatim.author: Maren Friedman Mayer
reviews_verbatim.text: He made my daughter's Simcha so beautiful with the food and dessert layout and it was all so delicious!

brand_vibe: No logo or brand colors found anywhere public. Base chosen: light, elegant, warm wine/burgundy accent on cream, fitting a formal event caterer (weddings, b'nai mitzvah, simchas) and distinct from already-used palettes per SKELETONS-V2.md.
